require 'thread'
require 'openssl'
require 'securerandom'
require 'base64'

module DbDriver
  class ConnectionPool
    POOL_SIZE = 5
    IDLE_TIMEOUT = 300

    def initialize(config)
      @config = config
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @connections = []
      @available = []
      @waiters = []
      @credential_cache = {}
      POOL_SIZE.times { @available << create_connection }
    end

    def checkout
      @mutex.synchronize do
        conn = @available.pop
        if conn.nil?
          if @connections.size < POOL_SIZE
            conn = create_connection
          else
            waiter = ConditionVariable.new
            @waiters << waiter
            waiter.wait(@mutex, 5)
            conn = @available.pop
            raise "Pool exhausted" if conn.nil?
          end
        end
        conn.last_checkout = Time.now
        conn
      end
    end

    def checkin(conn)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        if conn.elapsed_since_checkout > IDLE_TIMEOUT
          recycle_connection(conn)
        else
          @available << conn
        end
        if waiter = @waiters.shift
          waiter.signal
        end
      end
    end

    def pool_status
      @mutex.synchronize do
        {
          total: @connections.size,
          available: @available.size,
          cache_entries: @credential_cache.size
        }
      end
    end

    private

    def create_connection
      auth_token = derive_auth_token(@config[:username], @config[:password])
      conn = Connection.new(
        host: @config[:host],
        port: @config[:port],
        auth_token: auth_token,
        database: @config[:database]
      )
      cache_credentials(conn.object_id, auth_token)
      @connections << conn
      conn
    end

    def recycle_connection(conn)
      old_id = conn.object_id
      conn.disconnect!
      @connections.delete(conn)
      new_conn = create_connection
      @available << new_conn
      # Clean up old cache entry and migrate
      migrate_cache_entry(old_id, new_conn.object_id)
    end

    def derive_auth_token(username, password)
      salt = @config[:auth_salt] || SecureRandom.hex(16)
      key = OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(
        password,
        salt: salt,
        iterations: 10000,
        length: 32,
        hash: "sha256"
      )
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new("aes-256-gcm")
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = key
      iv = cipher.random_iv
      encrypted = cipher.update("#{username}:#{password}:#{Time.now.to_i}") + cipher.final
      tag = cipher.auth_tag
      Base64.strict_encode64(iv + tag + encrypted)
    end

    def cache_credentials(conn_id, auth_token)
      @credential_cache[conn_id] = {
        token: auth_token,
        token_hash: OpenSSL::Digest::SHA384.hexdigest(auth_token),
        cached_at: Time.now,
        username: @config[:username]
      }
    end

    def migrate_cache_entry(old_id, new_id)
      if entry = @credential_cache.delete(old_id)
        @credential_cache[new_id] = entry.merge(migrated_at: Time.now)
      end
    end
  end

  class Connection
    attr_accessor :last_checkout
    attr_reader :host, :port, :database

    def initialize(host:, port:, auth_token:, database:)
      @host = host
      @port = port
      @auth_token = auth_token
      @database = database
      @connected = true
      @last_checkout = Time.now
      perform_handshake
    end

    def elapsed_since_checkout
      Time.now - @last_checkout
    end

    def disconnect!
      @connected = false
      @auth_token = nil
    end

    def execute(query, params = [])
      raise "Not connected" unless @connected
      packet = build_query_packet(query, params)
      send_packet(packet)
    end

    def inspect
      "#<DbDriver::Connection host=#{@host} port=#{@port} db=#{@database}>"
    end

    private

    def perform_handshake
      # Protocol handshake simulation
      true
    end

    # Build a query packet using true parameter binding rather than
    # inline string interpolation, preventing SQL injection.
    def build_query_packet(query, params)
      # Validate that placeholder count matches provided params.
      placeholder_count = query.scan(/\$\d+/).map { |p| p[1..-1].to_i }.max || 0
      if placeholder_count != params.size
        raise ArgumentError, "parameter count mismatch: expected #{placeholder_count}, got #{params.size}"
      end

      # Serialize the parameterized query so the query text and the
      # parameter values are sent as separate, length-prefixed fields.
      # The server binds params server-side; no client-side string
      # interpolation of untrusted values into the SQL text occurs.
      query_bytes = query.dup.force_encoding(Encoding::BINARY)
      packet = [query_bytes.bytesize].pack('N') + query_bytes
      packet += [params.size].pack('N')
      params.each do |param|
        value = param.nil? ? "".b : param.to_s.dup.force_encoding(Encoding::BINARY)
        packet += [value.bytesize].pack('N') + value
      end
      packet
    end

    def send_packet(packet)
      # Simulated network send
      packet
    end
  end

  class PoolDiagnostics
    def initialize(pool)
      @pool = pool
    end

    def health_check
      status = @pool.pool_status
      {
        healthy: status[:available] > 0,
        utilization: ((status[:total] - status[:available]).to_f / status[:total] * 100).round(2),
        cache_size: status[:cache_entries]
      }
    end

    def dump_diagnostics
      # Safe: only returns non-sensitive pool metrics
      @pool.pool_status.merge(timestamp: Time.now.iso8601)
    end
  end
end
